name: Clarendon Park Primary School
address: Corner Church Road & 7th Avenue, Walmer, Gqeberha

fees.notes: Public primary school. School fees for 2026 by monthly debit order or EFT, payable in advance: R2,905 for 11 months, R31,955 as printed. Paid in full by 11 December 2025: R28,759.50 (a saving of R3,195.50). Paid in full by 31 January 2026: R29,718.00 (a saving of R2,237.00). The page doesn't split fees by grade. Optional aftercare: R1,525 per child per month for 11 months, R16,775 as printed, payable in advance; or R15,936.00 if paid by 31 January 2026 (a saving of R839.00). No registration fee is listed.

fees.notes: Independent primary school with boarding. 2026 tuition: Grade R R35,970 a year or R3,270 a month for 11 months (January to November), rising to R50,270 a year (R4,570 a month) for Grades 4 to 7. Pre-Primary is R12,870 (1 day), R21,230 (2-3 days) or R29,480 (4-5 days) a year, or R300 a day. A R1,200 non-refundable enrolment fee is paid on acceptance; the sheet doesn't say if it comes off the fees. Boarding (Grades R-7, Monday to Friday) is extra: see the boarding items. The book fee (once-off, Grades R-7) was not yet set on the sheet and is invoiced in Term 1; uniform has no price listed. Ask the school for both.

fees.notes: Public girls' high school with a hostel. 2026 school fees R57,156 a year, or R5,196 a month for 11 months (January to November, debit order). Pay the year before 28 February 2026 and the fee is R51,440. New learners pay a R50 application administration fee and a R5,000 admission orientation registration fee. Hostel is extra: R87,000 a year for Grades 8-11 (R78,300 if paid before 28 February 2026) or R21,750 a term; Grade 12 R87,000 (R78,300) or R29,000 before each of the first 3 terms. Hostel leavers in Grades 8-11 who don't give the required notice pay a penalty equal to three months' fees (no rand amount printed). Music (instrument hire or practical music) is R480 a month for 10 months, R1,200 a term or R4,800 a year. Hospitality/Consumer Studies (Food) R550 a year.
